reviews.text:
I have been looking for a place to get my cat washed and dried as she used to be a show cat and used to be groomed once a month before I got her. I have tried to wash and dry her before and it is not for me, she is great no scratching, hissing or biting, but takes well over an hour to dry Her,  with hair blanketing literally every inch of the bathroom.
A friend went to Pet Lux said Sahar was really great and he had a good experience (It’s my first experience with a groomer).   Sahar was on time very pleasant and loved Sadie which made me feel immediately at ease.  I picked her up exactly 1 hour later.  With a cute yellow bow
I was confused on the website and I picked a dog wash and brush by accident so I thought it was going to be 70 dollars but it was 95. Large jump in funds but I still found it worth it as I didn’t have to do it myself (although it does cost more than my hair)
I recommend Sahar and will bring Sadie back to her for sure.
They take amazing care of my very needy little Aussie doodle!

Our dog Russell went there a few weeks ago and had a great time. He’s usually anxious about going to the groomer, but this time he was completely relaxed when I picked him up. Very happy, and we’ll definitely be coming back.

Sahar did a great job with my Maltese Shih Tzu, Marco! He came home clean, fluffy and looking adorable. She was kind, patient and listened to exactly what I asked for. Will definitely be booking with Sahar again at the Pacific St location!

Zara did another excellent job of clipping Sherpa
Sherpa is very relaxed whenever I hand her to Zara and always comes back looking very neat and tidy
My 19 pound Maine Coon cat does NOT like the nail trim, strong grooming and tummy shave he needs . Sahara was fantastic with him. Careful, calm but firm, efficient in under an hour for full services.

Lady Sahar did a wonderful job washing and grooming my cat! My cat is a stray I adopted from a shelter, and she really doesn’t like water. Lady Sahar was incredibly patient and gentle while bathing her, cleaning her ears, and trimming her nails. She even stayed calm when my cat scratched her arm and never complained.

My cat came home happy, fresh, and smelling wonderful. Thank you so much, Lady Sahar, for taking such great care of her! I truly appreciate your patience and kindness. ❤️🐱
Sahar did a wonderful job with our long hair siberian cat! she listened to what we wanted and she was so sweet and gentle with him. super happy with Pet Lux’s cat grooming!

The team at Pet Lux are amazing.  I live nearby but had never been in to meet or take my dog there before.  My neighbour suggested I try them.  I made an on-line booking with ease - and they were ready for me when I took my standard poodle there.  He had been sprayed by a skunk - and I couldn't get an appointment with my regular grooming place for 3 weeks.  The ladies at Pet Lux took Aidan in as if he was a regular - and although nervous at first, they immediately made him feel at ease.  They did an excellent job - and demonstrated true care for him.  They even brushed his teeth - and prepared him for me to pick up with a cute bow tie.
I would highly recommend Pet Lux as a qualified, caring  team of people who I will be returning to in future.
Absolutely amazing, super friendly and cares for you dog. I’ll be a regular ☺️

Actually not sure how they got so many good reviews. I got a deluxe service but the nail trimming was barely done…also added anal gland expression service but my dog is still scooting after the grooming.
Had a great experience with Sahar from Pet Lux! My dog has anxiety and she was very accommodating, caring, and patient with him. Highly recommend!

My wife and I have been taking our 5-year-old rescue poodle to Sahar since we first got him over a year ago, and she has consistently done an amazing job. We are unsure of his background, so finding a groomer we completely trust has meant a lot to us. He genuinely loves going to see Sahar, which says everything!

She is incredibly caring, patient, and always does an amazing job grooming him. We also get his teeth cleaned, which he will only let her do. There is honestly no other groomer we would trust with him. We couldn’t recommend Sahar enough and will be going here for life!

Sahar did an absolutely amazing job with my dog Mia (who usually tends to not enjoy her "spa visits" very much!). But Mia looked great afterwards, and I will definitely come back. Great overall experience, and I'm so glad to have an awesome little grooming shop like this in the neighborhood!

I took my dog to Pet Lux Vancouver for grooming, and I couldn't be happier with the experience. The staff was welcoming, gentle, and clearly loves animals. They listened to exactly what I wanted, and the grooming turned out even better than I expected. My dog's coat was soft, shiny, and smelled amazing after the visit. The salon was clean, the service was professional, and the whole process was stress-free. I highly recommend Pet Lux Vancouver to anyone looking for a caring and skilled pet grooming team. We'll definitely be coming back!

Kristy is knowledgeable and trust worthy and always goes above and beyond to accommodate my anxious pup! I followed her from another pet grooming business to pet Lux because of this! She gives great recommendations for my pets health as well. :)
We have a large dog and have had a hard time finding a groomer.   Pet Lux did a fantastic job.  Every time we look at him we remark on how good he looks.  We will be going back.
Kristy did a wonderful job on Twix. I’m in the process of moving back to Vancouver and I got in immediately. Twix had a great experience. He looks so happy and clean!

Jina is amazing! She was very caring and very detailed, asked all the required information from us before getting started. She did an amazing job grooming our pet cat and paid close attention to all the requests we had. She put a cute bow tie on our pet cat after grooming and gave us a very good idea on the next steps to take the very best care. Highly recommend her!

We took our rescued cat, Sandy, to Pet Lux Vancouver for grooming. Sandy is a long-haired cat who came from a difficult situation after being abandoned by her previous owner. She was extremely matted, especially around her tummy and under her tail, and had become very sensitive to being touched. Building trust with her has taken time, and brushing her at home was nearly impossible as she would run away, hiss, and become very stressed.

After realizing how severe the matting had become, we booked an appointment with Pet Lux Vancouver Downtown. Our groomer, Jina, did a wonderful job. She was patient and professional, and she shaved Sandy evenly while safely removing all of the painful knots and mats. Sandy looked much more comfortable afterward, and we truly appreciated the care she received.

What stood out the most was how much better Sandy felt after the grooming. We could immediately see a difference in her behaviour. She became calmer, kinder, and more affectionate. We truly believe those mats and knots were causing her a lot of discomfort, constantly pulling on her skin. Since having them removed, she seems much happier and more relaxed.

The reason for 4 stars instead of 5 is that we booked the Deluxe Package, which included a bath, but when we picked Sandy up, it appeared that she had not been washed after the shave. We were told a dry shampoo had been used instead, and we're not entirely sure why the bath was omitted.

Additionally, the salon itself did not feel particularly clean or aesthetically appealing as we were hoping based on their website and reviews. However, the staff were kind, professional, and clearly cared about the animals.

Overall, we are grateful for the help they provided Sandy and especially thankful to Jina for making a difficult grooming experience much easier for our rescued girl. 🐱🧡

Kristy did such an amazing job with my westie dog Dalí. She was very kind and seem very keen in adjusting to my preferences for a Westie style. Dali and myself were very happy with the final result! I recommend her 100%
Sahar is the best pet groomer in Lower Mainland. She did a phenomenal job with my 13-year-old Golden Labrador. Highly recommended.

Kristy has been grooming my Pomeranian for seven years, and I only trust her. She is extremely skilled and always does an amazing job. Every time she grooms him I can’t believe how perfect the cut is! She does a scissor cut :) highly recommend!

Very bad haircut ! I think they’re new and do not know how to do a haircut ! Asked for a round face the ear trim is not similar to one another neither did the cut is good looking! I could’ve done way better job than this at home. DO NOT RECOMMEND
Cat grooming. They are number one. They know what they are doing.

I have brought Mango to Pet Lux two times now after struggling to find a dog groomer who would actually cut his nails properly and give him some real TLC. He loves it there and always comes out with his tail wagging and looking handsome. Thanks guys!
Sahar did a fantastic job grooming my cat, Poppy. She came out looking clean and relaxed. I will definitely be going back

I highly recommend Petlux Grooming Spa!

The groomer was extremely professional and explained everything she was going to do beforehand, which made me feel really comfortable leaving Pomi with them. You can tell they genuinely care about the dogs and pay attention to every detail.

I’m honestly so happy with the result — Pomi looks absolutely adorable and so well groomed 🥹

And I especially loved the little bow they added at the end, it was such a cute and thoughtful touch. A really sweet little gift from them 💜

Bella had a wonderful experience at Pet Lux today! After being rejected by 2 previous groomers, Sahar welcomed us in with open arms. Thank you Sahar and Ava for taking great care of Bella during her visit.

First time taking my cat for grooming. She is extremely docile so I wasn’t worried. The staff I spoke with were so nice and gave me tons of options. Beatrice looks better than she ever has. We will definitely be going back!!

Christy is a great groomer
Also listens and truly loves what she does
I highly recommend her
Just had my big fluffy kitty groomed by Sahar. She was lovely, and obviously cares very much for the precious pets we leave in her hands. I will definitely bring our fella back to her again.

We brought our 2 year old Maine Coon for a grooming with Sahar and we are very happy with how he turned out! We still have his beautiful long coat but it is now much more neat and he was so soft when we went to pick him up.

Sahar said he was such a good boy which means she has quite the magic touch as I myself cannot seem to brush his hair for that long. She seems to really love what she does and we could tell he was in good hands while he was with her.

Since he’s been here, he has actually been more open to having his hair brushed for longer periods now.

We would bring Casper here again and we highly recommend this location 100%
Sahar did a great job with the haircut and was incredibly kind and patient with my little guy, who is very fussy and anxious when it comes to grooming.
Sahar was great! She got rid of all the extra fluff on my pup and he even came back with a little bow-tie. Highly recommend!

Kristie was very fast and lovely for my girls first haircut, gave my girl a little
bow. She looks amazing. Its been couple days and she still smells great.
They did an amazing job de-hairing my shedding gsd/husky mix. Hes fidgety but they managed to clean him up great. Will be back! Friendly service at a great price
I took my cat to Ms. Sahar and she was great. She does a good job and interacts with the pet lovingly. We will definitely be going to her from now on.
Fast and professional. Glad to have this level of support for my cat who hates getting her nails done by me!

I highly recommend Sarah for cat grooming, she definitely has that "special touch" w cats! I have  brought my two big girls Millie and Chica and Sarah has worked miracles with them as I have tried myself to bathe them and became a nightmare. Sarah is so gentle and does an excellent detailed grooming.  Attaches is Millie after her grooming appt!!
Sahar did a great job!! My dog had extreme knots, and she took the time to brush it all out. While being gentle with him. My dog looks amazing. :)

I had a great experience at Pet Lux downtown. Jina was friendly, knowledgeable, and professional, and my brother’s dog looked wonderful after the Deluxe grooming. There was a small note about pricing being slightly higher next time due to the work required, but I still recommend Pet Lux for the quality of their service.
Best place for nice pet grooming… DuoDuo loves to go and look for Kirsty… she is amazing and great w my fluffy baby💕 …
Haven't seen anybody like Sahar, so professional, experienced and passionate. She is always accommodating and helpful.
I took my dog for washing and he came out super happy and smelling good with red bow tie. I would definitely recommend Sahar, she is super nice lady and knows how to make my dog happy:)
Sahar, is who we see. My Littlebear - hates going to the "dog spa". Sahar has a special way of making my dog feel cared for- he is happy when I pick him up.

Sahar was absolutely wonderful with my dog Akasha. She was so gentle, patient, and caring throughout the whole process. Akasha gets very nervous with baths, but Sahar handled her with such calm energy and kindness that it made a huge difference.
Had my sweet old kitty groomed here, they did an excellent job!! Very nice and caring employees, I definitely recommend them!!! 😻 …
Sahar did an amazing job with my mini poodle. Very kind and attentive ❤️

Sahar at Pet Luxe Grooming did an amazing job with my chihuahua! She was super gentle, worked fast, and my pup looks great. The whole appointment was quick and stress-free. You can tell she really knows what she’s doing. I’ll definitely be coming back!

Sahar is amazing! I have a doodle and she always does an amazing job with him, is super non-judgemental (even though doodles can have tough fur to groom, and is wonderful with my dog. She is definitely our favourite groomer :)
Sahar is absolutely amazing. My dogs are usually irritated when it comes to grooming they were amazingly comfortable and relaxed when I picked them up. Thanks again!

I can’t recommend Sahar enough! My medium poodle came in with some pretty ugly mats that I was worried about, but Sahar handled them perfectly.

She did such a fantastic job grooming him, and I really appreciated how patient she was. She fed him plenty of treats to keep him happy and comfortable the whole time. He looks great, we will definitely be back!

I took my little puppy for grooming for first time  and my Kiddo really loved Sahar. She made her feel so relaxed and loved and I was also very confident that Kiddo is in great hands. Thank you Sahar for loving Kiddo and taking care of her. I’m sure she is looking forward to seeing Sahar again :)

We take our little dog, Shiny, here to Sahar on regular basis and it’s amazing! We are always happy with the service and Shiny seems to enjoy it! Absolutely recommend Sahar and Pet Lux for the grooming of your pets :-)

Today we had a great experience  at Pet Lux Vancouver grooming salon. Seher was very kind, patient, and attentive. She listened carefully to our requests and treated our dog with so much care and compassion. The grooming turned out exactly as we wanted, and our dog looked wonderful and was calm afterward. Highly recommended!
I took my dog for grooming with Sahar and had a great experience. Very gentle and professional. The red bow at the end was a lovely touch. Highly recommend!
Fantastic & Superb grooming experience from Jina of Pet Lux Downtown! - george 🐾🐕‍🦺 …

Lizzie (Yorkie) & Fabi (Maltese)had a great experience at Pet Lux today. Kristy turned my two scruffy looking girls into runway models!
Thanks Kristy & Pet Lux, fabulous work!

I took my cat to Jina for grooming and I’m honestly so impressed!
She did an amazing job with the bath, teeth cleaning, and nail trimming.
My cat came back looking fresh and relaxed, with zero signs of stress.
She was friendly and gentle, and you can tell they genuinely care about animals.
Definitely coming back!

For the past year, I've been bringing my dogs to Pet Luxe's downtown location, and I can't say enough good things about  AVA (SAHAR). AVA (SAHAR) is truly amazing and so flexible with scheduling. I've shown AVA photos of how I want my dog to look, and AVA’s always nailed it, delivering exactly what I had in mind. I'm consistently pleased with the results and highly recommend AVA (SAHAR)!
Sahar does an excellent job grooming my Cavapoo Freya.

Sahar was amazing with our dog! His cut was not only perfect, but she made me feel so comfortable leaving him as you can tell she loves on your doggy. When I picked him up he was licking her and wagging his tail so he clearly loved her!

check your pets thoroughly before leaving the shop.

We took our puppy to Pet Lux Vancouver for grooming. They was very friendly with dogs, started playing with our baby as soon as we arrived, which made us feel comfortable right away. The haircut was done okay overall, and our dog seemed happy after the session.

However, when we got home, we noticed the hair on her paws and legs was still too long. Since it’s winter, that means her legs can easily get wet and tangled, which becomes painful for her to be brushed. I called Sahar and explained and she said she would arrange for us to come back in a couple of days. Unfortunately, after that call, we couldn’t reach her again — no one answered, and no one called back. After waiting over a week with no response, we are now going to take her somewhere else.

We paid over $115, and for that price we expected to be fully satisfied. Unfortunately, we’re not, and we will not be returning.
We recommend that other pet owners check their pets thoroughly before leaving the shop, as it seems difficult to get a hold of them afterwards

Gina was incredible with my Persian cat. My cat had been to the vet over the weekend and had an enema done (I won’t go into details) and really needed to be groomed as it was stressing her as she has a long coat. I explained to Gina that she is nervous and jumpy at the moment, and asked her to be very gentle as she has a sore tummy. I expected that my cat would come out and want to go straight home, but when she was brought out in her bag, she was so clean and soft and she was purring and calmer than she’s been in days! She took such good care of her and even took photos of her bath time 🫧 I wouldn’t easily trust somebody to groom my lovely girl when she is in a nervous state, but after reading Gina’s reviews I luckily took the chance! She is wonderful and my cat is happier than ever. Thank you so much Gina for your care and for wonderful job you did! 💕💕 P.S. Maxie looks grumpy in the photos, thats just her face
My 4 month old puppy had his first ever  grooming with Sahar. He was so happy afterwards and Sahar did a great job!

I’m absolutely thrilled with my dog’s haircut from Pet Lux! The groomers did an amazing job — the cut is clean, stylish, and exactly what I asked for. My pup looks adorable (and smells great!) with his new bow tie and perfect trim. You can really tell they care about the pets and take their time to make them comfortable. Highly recommend Pet Lux for anyone who wants their dog looking and feeling their best! 🐾✨

Awesome!!! Sahar took such great care of my 80lb pup. He enjoyed his time and came back super clean. He had really dirty ears from all the playing he does and so it was nice to get those cleaned out as well.

First time visiting Petlux and only the second time my duck toller had been groomed in 5 years.  It’s hard to find a groomer who will take large dogs.    Saha did an amazing job,  taking my requests into account.  I will be coming back on a regular basis!

Amazing experience at Pet Lux!! I have two exotic shorthair cats and Jina did a lovely job grooming them and caring for them. They came out with the cutest trim and smelling delicious. I couldn’t be happier with the service. Best of all, they each got a bow for that extra special touch!! I look forward to our next visit. Thank you!!

If you want your small breed dog to be groomed by the most experienced and gifted small breed groomer, and you live in the Lower Mainland, you're in luck because that's where the most experienced and gifted groomer happens to be, and I swear to g-d I'm not exaggerating! Her name is Kristy and she has 25 years plus experience, and is the most talented groomer I've ever come across.  For the past 20+ years Kristy has groomed all of my champion show Yorkies and Pomeranians. She offers her grooming expertise to the public, and continues to groom champion show dogs including her own to magnificent breed-specific show standards, some of which compete in the Westminster Dog Show in New York City. I wouldn't even think about trusting anyone else, and I travel to Vancouver specifically to get my dogs groomed by Kristy...until the unthinkable happened...
When I contacted the other nearby grooming business in Vancouver (barking babies) to book an appointment for Kristy to groom my dogs, I was told by the owner Nancy that she no longer worked there. I asked if they knew where she was currently working, and not surprisingly, since she is a nasty piece of work, she said "no I have no idea where she is". I was recently speaking to a friend about
my dilemma and she said ,"Oh, Kristy is working at Lux Pet in both West Van and the downtown location. I was beyond thrilled and immediately arranged to bring my dogs in for grooming. So if you're looking for the best of the best I guarantee that you will be thrilled with her work.

This is the fourth session my golden retriever has had with Sahar at Pet Lux Vancouver. Every-time she is super relaxed and walks away refreshed. Sahar is the type of person you want to take care of your paw friends. Kind and gentle.

We love this place, especialy Jina. We’ve gone to different places but never felt happy with their work. Bringing Barky back after he was groomed by Jina, all our friends were amazed because he looked so cute. Jina listened to my request very carefully and she had the job done exactly like what I expected. We will definitely become their new loyal customer!

Sahar did a wonderful job with our Coton de Tulear. Daisy doesn't always make friends easily but she liked Sahar a lot!
Highly recommend.
Gina did a fantastic job grooming our nervous, 5-month old puppy, Millie! We were so delighted with her  puppy cut and the gentle care provided!
We just had a great experience. Jina gave our cat the best service and he came home with a bowtie on! We will be back.
Sahar is absolutely amazing. My cat and dog were relaxed and looking amazing after their treatment. Definitely recommend!

I’m extremely disappointed with this grooming experience. I took my puppy here with very specific instructions — her coat should only be trimmed with scissors, not clippers. Unfortunately, they ignored that and completely ruined her fur texture and style. The haircut she received was nothing like what I asked for.

To make matters worse, they rescheduled my appointment at the last minute, asking me to bring her in earlier because they “had to leave early.” It felt rushed and unprofessional, and it clearly showed in the result. My puppy came back looking uneven, with her paws poorly trimmed and her overall coat damaged.

I trusted them with my little one, and instead of taking their time and care, they did a quick job that left her looking and feeling uncomfortable. I would not recommend this place to anyone who truly cares about their pet’s well-being and grooming standards.

Very disappointed with this grooming service. I usually pay $90 for my long-haired, double-coated Chihuahua, but this time I was charged $140 without any explanation. They even called me the same day asking if I could come in earlier — as if people don’t plan their schedules in advance. It’s also obvious they used clippers instead of scissors, which should never be done on a double-coated dog. The coat looks uneven and damaged; was she in a rush? I don’t know — but absolutely avoid this place. They didn’t even bother to put the little bow this time. You’re better off going to BB instead.

I’m so happy with the grooming service! Jina was kind, fast  and made my dogs feel completely at ease. My dogs came out looking absolutely adorable — clean, fluffy, and smelling amazing! I can tell she truly care about the pets. Everything from the booking to pickup was smooth and friendly. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a reliable and caring grooming salon!

Jina is truly the best cat groomer in Vancouver! We had tried a few different groomers before, but our cat always came home stressed and anxious. After visiting Jina, though, everything changed — our cat came back calm, happy, and so comfortable. She handled the matted fur with incredible care and skill. You can really tell she loves what she does. I highly recommend Jina to anyone looking for a gentle and professional groomer — we’ll only trust her with our cat from now on!

Quite a disappointing experience. I called ahead to confirm that I wanted a full grooming — including a haircut, bath, and wash. The person on the phone asked my dog’s weight, and I told her 55 lbs. She clearly said that since it’s over 40 lbs, the cost would be $135.

After driving 30 minutes to get there, I was told the price would actually be $160 because my dog weighs 55 lbs. Their own menu says “over 40 lbs — $135,” and I had confirmed the price beforehand.

Very poor communication and misleading pricing. I’d give zero stars if I could.

I brought my puppy in couple months ago for a basic grooming session to help with his socialization. After checking out a few places, I decided to book with Sahar. She was amazing with him — so calming that he even fell asleep during his session! We have been making regular appointments with Sahar ever since :)

I had a fantastic experience with Sahar at Pet Lux today. I had to bring in my senior dog, who unfortunately hadn’t been able to be groomed in some time. She was incredibly patient, listening to my concerns and requests, which I had quite a few. Sahar was also very clearly good with animals and knowledgeable. When I went to pick him up, he was the happiest and most relaxed he’d ever been at a groomers. Overall, I had a very positive experience and would happily return.

I took my cat Yoyo in for grooming, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. Sahar did an amazing job! She was so sweet and gentle with Yoyo, who is usually quite shy and doesn’t do well with strangers. Despite that, Sahar managed to make him feel comfortable and handled everything with such care and professionalism.
You can tell she really loves animals and knows how to work with them. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a skilled and compassionate groomer!
My dog really likes Jina and always comes home excited after grooming. She also makes sure the cut looks just the way I want, super cute every time. I highly recommend her!
Jina was so good to work with! She did amazing, and she was kind and generous ☺️
Sahar was great!
A great job on my 2 chows . Ace and Cosi. Sahar is amazing. It was my 1 st time I wished I heard of them before. Great job

I took my English Springer Spaniel to see Sahar and it was an amazing experience. She immediately greeted and got my pup comfortable as it was her first time there. Cut was great and highly recommend! Thank you Sahar!

**update - Sahar is still the best! I mistakenly booked the wrong location and Sahar still welcomed me and worked tirelessly to accommodate Stevie and a grooming today and of course it was immaculate!! I just can’t recommend this place enough.

Really happy with the work done here. I've been getting my dog's nails trimmed here for a while now but finally decided to get her groomed. Her fur looks great, feels really soft and I'm pleased with the trimming done as well. Thank you Sahar!

I’ve changed my groomer completely to Lux. My toy poodle always comes out happy & immaculate. The groomers are always personable, friendly and efficient. Their prices are reasonable leaving more room for tips. My dog really enjoys his time there, he’s all wags. I feel I’ve found the best fit for myself and my dog.

Sahar genuinely cares about her clients; she is very attentive to the requests and provides helpful suggestions.

My cat easily gets cold and the last time we had the bath he was shivering for quite a while afterwards... I mentioned it to Sahar and this time my cat was just all cheers and joy when we came home. I also asked for no bowtie since my cat doesn't like wearing anything, Sahar made a note about it and also asked if I mind the perfume that they put at the end. I was very glad that she brought it up because I totally forgot I wanted to ask for no perfume this time.

My cat also used to fold
his right ear and turns out it was very dirty on the inside... I am very grateful that Sahar managed to clean it out 🙏😸

Sahar was so patient and lovely and took such good care of my newly adopted Persian cat. No nicks or cuts whatsoever and he’s not even hiding after being groomed. I’ll come back for a lion cut next time :).

Lazy Sunday groomer didn’t want to do my dog. Her excuse was “she can’t do dogs over 40lbs” I let her know my dog is 37lbs, and she still cancels the apt. And then books him in as large not medium for his next apt 🤣 …

My second time here! Today Jina was our groomer she was amazing! My cat is very stressed and he was full of knots. She was patient and could actually shave him. By the time I came to pick him up, he was doing just fine, and even home not he wasn’t getting fussy as she didn’t use strong scents on him.

Thank you for taking care of my kitty.
We had a wonderful experience with Kristy today! Simon looks amazing—exactly like the photo we showed her—and he’s very happy. The service was quick, yet the quality was excellent. Highly recommend!
Awesome, above all expectations and wonderful work.Although my dog doesn’t usually like grooming, she loves this place.

I've been here twice primarily because of proximity. Not the best experience both times.

The first time, I called and checked for availability and I was told that I could walk-in. I walked in and the person there was very disappointed that I showed up without booking an appointment. Clearly a disconnect between the representative over phone vs the one who was in the store. Anyways they were kind and did the job OK.

Recently I checked in person again for availability for a nail trim while I was walking by with my dog, but they were busy and I was asked to come back after 30 mins or book an appointment online. Totally fair! I specifically checked if their online system is up-to-date and they confirmed it orally. I went back home and booked an appointment for after 5 pm on one of the days that followed, for a time that's convenient based on my work schedule. On the day of, I got a call saying I should come before 4:30 pm as they'll be wrapping up things by then. I asked why's that the case and they said the website isn't always right and is confusing. IF that were the case, why does the online system allow me to book? IF that were the case, why did the previous person I talked to in the store say the system is up-to-date.
Anyway, I walked in when I can possibly squeeze in between my work schedule. They recognized they'd called me before asking me to come earlier than my appointment time, so they took our dog in. The dog was fine but the nails were poorly clipped/trimmed with the tips of the poorly done nails had 'bristles' left out not trimmed cleanly. POOR JOB! I realized all that only after I walked out; must have checked in store.
On top of that, while we were there, I picked up a treat for our dog. The treat was added to the bill and the tip I added was on top of the treat's price and not just the service (which was poor in the first place).  😕

While a lot of people love this place, I haven't had a end-to-end good experience here. I do not think I'll go back.
Christie is my go to girl for grooming my dogs I’ve been following her for many years and now that she’s at pet Lux. I will continue to see her there five stars.

Jina at Pet Lux did a phenomenal job with Pickle!

I was in a bind and needed some urgent assistance on short notice and Jina was able to fit me in and take care of my baby!

Pickle isn't very fond of water but Jina was able to do a fantastic job with the wash and sanitary trim.

I am exceptionally pleased with the customer service and quality of work that she provided.

Thank you Jina!

Gina helped my cat Daisy! It was Daisy 's first time for hair trim and bath.  I was worried how she reacts, but Gina did a great job for lion cut and de-matt her fur! Definitely I will go back for her service! Thank you Gina!

We recently rescued a 4-year-old poodle who was in desperate need of a groom, and we couldn’t be happier with his haircut from Sahar! We were a bit nervous going in, but Sahar took such wonderful care of him - he left looking adorable and was genuinely very happy.
